test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Amit covers a certain distance on his bike at a speed of 40 km/h in 15 min. If he wants to cover the same distance in 12 min, then what should his speed be?
solution:
**Given:**

Amit covers a certain distance on his bike at a speed of 40 km/h in 15 min.

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question

The distance will be = (40 × 15)/60 = 10 km

Now,

Time = 12 min = 12/60 = 1/5 hours

Now to calculate the speed of the bike

⇒ 10/(1/5)

⇒ 50 km/h

**∴ The required speed is 50 km/h**
